rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for someone who lacks social know-how and often says or does the wrong thing.

example.english: They asked how much the salary was at their first interview; they were really gauche.
example.traditional: 佢第一次見工就問人哋人工幾多，真係唔識做人。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dai6 jat1 ci3 gin3 gung1 zau6 man6 jan4 dei6 jan4 gung1 gei2 do1 zan1 hai6 m4 sik1 zou6 jan4

rows.note: Use this when the person's behavior is specifically embarrassing, improper, or likely to offend others.

example.english: You said the food was bad in front of the host at their home; that was gauche.
example.traditional: 你喺人哋屋企當住主人面話啲餸難食，真係失禮。
example.jyutping: nei5 hai2 jan4 dei6 uk1 kei2 dong1 zyu6 zyu2 jan4 min6 waa6 di1 sung3 naan4 sik6 zan1 hai6 sat1 lai5

rows.note: Use this when gauche behavior mainly suggests unsophisticated, unfashionable, or socially uncultured taste.

example.english: They wore a shiny suit to the wedding; the look was really gauche.
example.traditional: 佢去婚禮著件閃到反光嘅西裝，個款真係老土。
example.jyutping: keoi5 heoi3 fan1 lai5 zoek3 gin6 sim2 dou3 faan2 gwong1 ge3 sai1 zong1 go3 fun2 zan1 hai6 lou5 tou2
